meta.title: Android/JVM toolchain
meta.description: Shares one arm64 JDK + Gradle toolchain and runs every Gradle build through a queued single slot per root, so parallel agent sessions cannot exhaust the device. Use the android MCP tools (android_status first) or the android-build CLI; register a second root for its own slot. Local JVM/AGP builds only: NDK/C++ still needs a remote x86_64 builder.
